parameters.interpretation: An exact mathematical operating point, not a physical detector calibration or recommended experiment.

normal_approximation_theorem.scope: iid centered unit-variance random variables with finite third absolute moment; applied separately under each conditional count law.

normal_constant_certificate.method: Machin arctangent identity; alternating arctangent bounds; integer square-root enclosures.

explicit_rational_score_test.rule: If all counts are <=24, choose A when sum(weights[count]) >= m*per_snapshot_threshold, else B. If any count is >24, choose A. All weights and the threshold are rational.

proof_scope: Depends on retained exact moments and probability intervals; does not regenerate geometric moments.
All normal-CDF, log, square-root, tail-transfer, and endpoint inequalities are rigorously enclosed with rational arithmetic.
A normal approximation without its explicit Berry–Esseen error is not used as a proof.
The optimal sample count lies in the certified interval; its exact integer value remains undetermined.
Known calibrated competing models only; no nuisance-estimation or experimental-feasibility claim.
